g.text: C5VRX_JACK_DIY_V2 / FAT SHARK DOMINATOR + 3.5MM AV - XIAO THT CARRIER

g.desc: C5VRX_JACK_DIY_V2 / FAT SHARK DOMINATOR + 3.5MM AV - XIAO THT CARRIER

g.text: Only 5V, GND and VIDEO connected at the goggle bay.

g.desc: Only 5V, GND and VIDEO connected at the goggle bay.

g.text: D4..D9 = DAC bit 0..5. Use XIAO firmware pin mapping.

g.desc: D4..D9 = DAC bit 0..5. Use XIAO firmware pin mapping.

g.text: Component side: header RIGHT, USB LEFT.

g.desc: Component side: header RIGHT, USB LEFT.

g.text: Fit R8/R9 and use matching DAC firmware.

g.desc: Fit R8/R9 and use matching DAC firmware.

g.text: SJ1: solder bridge for bay power.

g.desc: SJ1: solder bridge for bay power.

g.text: XIAO BOOT button controls the firmware menu.

g.desc: XIAO BOOT button controls the firmware menu.

g.text: R1..R7: axial through-hole, DIN0207 / 0.25W, 10.16 mm lead pitch.

g.desc: R1..R7: axial through-hole, DIN0207 / 0.25W, 10.16 mm lead pitch.

g.text: XIAO: plug-in mounting on 2 x 7-pin headers.

g.desc: XIAO: plug-in mounting on 2 x 7-pin headers.

g.text: Decoupling is provided on the XIAO module.

g.desc: Decoupling is provided on the XIAO module.

g.text: REV B: R8 16k / D10 and R9 32k / D3 are DNP.

g.desc: REV B: R8 16k / D10 and R9 32k / D3 are DNP.

g.text: PR259 remains 6-bit. 8-bit: D9..D4 = bits 7..2, D10 = bit 1, D3 = bit 0.

g.desc: PR259 remains 6-bit. 8-bit: D9..D4 = bits 7..2, D10 = bit 1, D3 = bit 0.

g.text: Populate only with wider DAC firmware and loaded CVBS / D3 boot validation.

g.desc: Populate only with wider DAC firmware and loaded CVBS / D3 boot validation.

g.text: Choose one complete DAC set to match the firmware. No extra 75-ohm shunt.

g.desc: Choose one complete DAC set to match the firmware. No extra 75-ohm shunt.
